div.div: 2 سجّف البَيْتَ , (K,) inf. n. تَسْجِيفٌ, (TA,) He let down the curtain (السَّجْف) upon [the entrance of] the tent, or chamber; as also ↓ سَجَفَهُ , and ↓ اسجفه : (K, TA:) accord. to the T, التَّسْجِيف signifies the letting down of the سَجْفَانِ [or two separate halves, that hang side by side, of a curtain]: accord. to the M, the letting down of the curtain. (TA. [See also what next follows.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
